papers.title_en: Multi-Sensor Fusion for Human Gait Phenotyping: IMU, EMG, and Plantar Pressure Integration
papers.title_zh: 用于人体步态表型分析的多传感器融合：IMU、肌电与足底压力整合
papers.abstract_en: This study presents a novel multi-sensor fusion framework combining inertial measurement units (IMU), surface electromyography (sEMG), and plantar pressure data for comprehensive gait phenotyping. Sixty healthy adults performed standardized walking and running trials. Principal component analysis revealed distinct movement phenotypes explaining 73% of inter-individual variance. The integrated approach demonstrated superior classification accuracy (94.2%) compared to single-sensor modalities.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种新型多传感器融合框架，整合惯性测量单元（IMU）、表面肌电图（sEMG）和足底压力数据，用于全面的步态表型分析。60名健康成年人完成了标准化步行和跑步测试。主成分分析揭示了能解释73%个体间差异的独特运动表型。与单传感器模态相比，整合方法表现出更高的分类精度（94.2%）。

papers.title_en: Creatine Supplementation and Muscle Recovery Following Eccentric Exercise: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.title_zh: 肌酸补充与离心运动后肌肉恢复：系统综述与荟萃分析
papers.abstract_en: We systematically reviewed the evidence for creatine monohydrate supplementation on recovery biomarkers following eccentric exercise. Analysis of 24 RCTs (n=612) demonstrated significant reductions in creatine kinase (SMD=-0.68, 95%CI: -0.94 to -0.42) and perceived muscle soreness (SMD=-0.55, 95%CI: -0.78 to -0.32). Loading protocols (20g/day×5 days) showed superior effects compared to maintenance dosing.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们系统回顾了肌酸一水合物补充对离心运动后恢复生物标志物的证据。对24项随机对照试验（n=612）的分析显示，肌酸激酶（SMD=-0.68，95%CI：-0.94至-0.42）和肌肉酸痛感（SMD=-0.55，95%CI：-0.78至-0.32）显著降低。负荷方案（20g/天×5天）与维持剂量相比效果更优。

papers.title_en: Rate of Force Development as a Predictor of Athletic Performance: A Longitudinal Analysis
papers.title_zh: 力量发展速率作为运动表现预测指标：纵向分析
papers.journal: International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance
papers.abstract_en: Rate of force development (RFD) measured at 0-50ms, 0-100ms, and 0-200ms time intervals was assessed in 89 collegiate athletes over two competitive seasons. Early-phase RFD (0-50ms) demonstrated the strongest correlation with sprint performance (r=-0.74, p<0.001) and countermovement jump height (r=0.71, p<0.001). Neuromuscular training interventions targeting early-phase RFD produced 18% improvements in sprint times.
papers.abstract_zh: 在89名大学生运动员的两个竞技赛季中，测量了0-50ms、0-100ms和0-200ms时间间隔的力量发展速率（RFD）。早期RFD（0-50ms）与短跑成绩（r=-0.74，p<0.001）和反向跳高度（r=0.71，p<0.001）的相关性最强。针对早期RFD的神经肌肉训练干预使短跑时间提高了18%。

papers.title_en: Movement Phenotype Classification Using Wearable Sensors and Machine Learning in Recreational Runners
papers.title_zh: 利用可穿戴传感器和机器学习对休闲跑者进行运动表型分类
papers.abstract_en: This study developed a machine learning pipeline for classifying movement phenotypes in 120 recreational runners using a tri-axial IMU placed at the lumbar spine. A random forest classifier achieved 91.3% accuracy in identifying four distinct running phenotypes associated with injury risk. Longitudinal tracking revealed phenotype stability over 12 weeks, suggesting these represent genuine biomechanical signatures rather than task-specific adaptations.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究开发了一种机器学习管道，利用放置在腰椎处的三轴IMU对120名休闲跑者的运动表型进行分类。随机森林分类器在识别与损伤风险相关的四种不同跑步表型时达到了91.3%的准确率。纵向追踪显示表型在12周内保持稳定，表明这些代表了真正的生物力学特征而非任务特异性适应。

papers.title_en: Collagen Peptide Supplementation and Tendon Biomechanics: Structural and Functional Adaptations
papers.title_zh: 胶原肽补充与肌腱生物力学：结构和功能适应
papers.abstract_en: We investigated the effects of 15g/day collagen peptide supplementation combined with vitamin C on Achilles tendon stiffness and cross-sectional area in 44 recreational athletes over 12 weeks. Ultrasound elastography revealed significant increases in tendon stiffness (+12.4%, p=0.003) and collagen fibril density in the supplementation group. Concurrent eccentric exercise training amplified these adaptations, supporting a synergistic mechanism.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了15g/天胶原肽补充结合维生素C对44名休闲运动员跟腱刚度和横截面积12周的影响。超声弹性成像显示补充组肌腱刚度显著增加（+12.4%，p=0.003），胶原纤维密度也有所提升。同期离心运动训练放大了这些适应，支持协同机制。

papers.title_en: Muscle Synergy Analysis During Running at Different Speeds: Implications for Fatigue and Performance
papers.title_zh: 不同速度跑步时的肌肉协同分析：对疲劳和表现的影响
papers.abstract_en: Surface EMG from 16 lower limb muscles was recorded during treadmill running at 8, 10, 12, and 14 km/h in 28 trained runners. Non-negative matrix factorization identified 4 dominant muscle synergies accounting for >90% of EMG variance. Synergy structure remained consistent across speeds, but synergy activation coefficients showed speed-dependent modulation. Fatigue-induced synergy merging (3→2 synergies) predicted performance decrements with 85% sensitivity.
papers.abstract_zh: 记录了28名训练有素跑者在跑台上以8、10、12和14km/h速度跑步时16块下肢肌肉的表面肌电。非负矩阵分解识别出4个主要肌肉协同，解释了>90%的肌电方差。协同结构在不同速度下保持一致，但协同激活系数显示出速度依赖的调制。疲劳诱导的协同合并（3→2个协同）以85%的敏感性预测了表现下降。
